notes.title: Hotfix #1 - Achievements.
notes.content:
[h1]Pirates![/h1]
Seems that the curse of the Island of the Damned has prevented you from getting any achievements in the release version of the Pirate Cove Simulator. The evil sea sprites responsible have been tracked down and bribed with shiny trinkets to stay the heck away from your game progress. The achievements should now work as designed. We're sorry for the inconvenience this might have caused you!

May Lady Luck smile upon your enterprises!
[h2]Kool2Play[/h2]

notes.title: Arrr! Pirate Cove Simulator is here, get the sweet special release deal, matey!
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy, Pirates![/h2][p]The word from the crow's nest is that [b]Pirate Cove Simulator[/b] has launched! You're about to step in the shoes (well, a shoe and a peg) of an unfortunate pirate captain whose ship got hit by a mysterious storm. You'll wake up on the Island of the Damned, where pirate legends lead their rum-filled afterlife. Or they would, if someone knew how to operate the distillery. That someone - is YOU![/p][previewyoutube="lsHqs_OERhE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Pirate Cove Simulator[/b], currently available 10% off in the release period, is the second in our series of light-hearted retail sims with a bit of adventure. The other one, [b]Alchemy Shop Simulator[/b], is currently discounted by a whole 30% to mark the occasion. We would also like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who supported our previous launch. For that reason, we've set up a special bundle. If you own Alchemist Shop Simulator you can grab the new game, Pirate Cove simulator with [i]additional [/i]20% discount.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56896/Piracy_and_Alchemy/"][/dynamiclink]Don't wait! There's a lot of thirsty, dried-out pirate skeletons out there, who need their drinks, fish, and piracy supplies. Trust us - it will feel like a tropical paradise vacation (with some horror undertone).

May the fortune favor you, captains![/p][h3]Kool2Play[/h3]

notes.title: 21 July 2025 is the new release date
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy, Salty Dogs![/h2][p]
[b]Pirate Cove Simulator[/b] was scheduled to launch today. Unfortunately, due to some circumstances beyond our control, we need to postpone the launch. We don't want to force the players to wait too long, so we only push the release date by 7 days. Our pirate-themed funny retail sim will arrive on [b]Monday, July 21st[/b].[/p][previewyoutube="lsHqs_OERhE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We know there's a lot of people here to play our follow-up to Alchemist Shop Simulator, especially now, when we've showed off the release trailer. We are sorry for any inconvenience this slight delay might be causing you, but we were left with no good alternatives that would allow us to keep the original launch date.[/p][p][/p][p]We also want to take this opportunity to announce the pricing. The game will be sold at an $9.99 regular price, and there will be release discount throughout the entire launch period. On top of that, if you already own [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043310/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator"]Alchemist Shop Simulator[/url][/b], you'll get an even better deal with our complete-your-collection bundle.[/p][p][/p][p]Again, we apologize you won't be playing the game today, but we believe it will be well worth the wait![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for understanding, 
the [b]Kool2Play Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p]PS. If you're a content creator eyeing the game for your YouTube or Twitch channel this delay might come as a fortunate development, as it gives you an extra week to [url="https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/70ad0866"]pick up your key from KeyMailer[/url], and give your audience a tour of the Island of the Damned![/p][p][url="https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/70ad0866" style="button" buttoncolor="#000000"]Pirate Cove Simulator on KeyMailer[/url][/p]

notes.title: Release Day Announcement - Pirate Cove Simulator arrives on July 14th!
notes.content:
[h2]Arrr, Mateys![/h2][p][/p][p]It is our great pleasure to announce the release date for [b]Pirate Cove Simulator[/b], the second game in our retail sim line-up (after [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043310/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator/"]Alchemist Shop Simulator[/url]). We'll be shipping off to the tropical shores of the pirate afterlife on Monday, July 14th, 2025. That's right, just short three weeks from now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290660/Pirate_Cove_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you haven't yet - make sure to hit that WISHLIST button in the widget above. This way, we can e-mail you and remind you of the release once the game launches. And you will want to be reminded, because the game will come with a sweet 10% OFF launch discount (while the regular price has been set at $9.99), giving you the chance to jump right into the pirate trading action. [/p][p][/p][p]At this point we would also like to thank all of the Steam players who picked up the...[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678570/Pirate_Cove_Simulator_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]...Pirate Cove Simulator Demo on Steam Next Fest (and before). We got a ton of useful feedback from you folks, not to mention that with the end of the Fest we've reached the goal of 13.5k wishlists! You're awesome!

Stay on the lookout for more Pirate Cove Simulator news in these coming weeks. And if you're a content creator eyeing our game - do not hesitate one second, just head out to [b]KeyMailer[/b] and request an advance preview of the full game.[/p][h3]
May the four winds winds be in your favor! Yours,[/h3][h2]
Kool2Play Team[/h2]
